Warmer → higher notes. Every year gets the same amount of time. Musical scales round pitch; the chart always shows the original values.

LISTEN WITH CONTEXT

A rising note tells a story.

Each note is one year’s global temperature anomaly. Positive means warmer than the 1951–1980 average; negative means cooler. These are global averages, not temperatures in a particular city.
